title: Born of the Fire-Pit of Awareness
source_seed: Seed 1: Rising from the fire-pit of awareness (Lalita Sahasranama verses 1 to 3; Lalitopakhyana emergence). The fire itself is left out; only the radiance and the 'coming into being' are used.
logline: She closes her eyes and draws one deep breath that gathers a rose-gold light, then opens her eyes and the radiance flows out across the water.
hook: Her eyes close slowly and her chest and shoulders rise on a deep breath in the first second.
story: The text has her arise as pure awareness whose radiance fills the world. Here that is one breath: she gathers the light into herself, wakes, and sends it outward over the dark water and the lotus. It is her coming into being, in her own light.
loop: The radiance settles back around her and the gentle smile of frame 1 returns.
share_trigger: Sent at the start of a hard day or a new chapter; 'take a breath and begin'.
caption_hook: Before the first light, there was only one breath. Then she woke.
audio: Eerie, building: near-silence and a deep breath-like swell, a low drone rising in pitch, then deep frame drums at a faster 120 bpm Nordic-style pulse with a droning throat-sung line as the eyes open; abrupt softening at the end.

shots.camera: Eye level, front-facing, full-length framing from the reference portrait, held steady, with the tall crown and crescent moon centered and fully framed.
shots.action: Her eyes close slowly and She draws one deep breath, Her chest and shoulders rising and Her posture lengthening, and a warm rose-gold radiance gathers close around Her body as the breath fills. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: The breath is the action; the gathering radiance is its consequence.

shots.camera: A slow, small pull-back at eye level so the water around the lotus is visible, the crown and crescent moon centered and fully framed.
shots.action: Her eyes open and settle on the viewer, and the gathered radiance flows outward from Her in slow rose-gold rings across the dark water around the lotus as She exhales and Her gentle smile returns. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: Waking is the payoff: her light flows out into the world.
